headline: Discovery redesigned and verified locally; event-details review is next.
summary: Owner asks for stronger product design, event atmosphere, less text and easier nearby discovery/joining. Gesture suggestions are exploratory, not rules. The team is choosing the interaction autonomously against comprehension and useful real-world participation, not novelty alone.

Implemented bold sport invitations, finite Previous/Next browsing, a grid alternative, visible approximate search area and compact filters. Mobile visual review reduced hero/artwork height. View the plan preserves explicit requests. Verified 1,201 web tests (14 skipped), typecheck, lint (0 errors/11 existing warnings), production build and actual-page synthetic browser checks at 390px normal/reduced motion and 1280px. No production fixture creation or network requests.

Research reviewed working patterns from Partiful Explore, Luma Discover and DICE: event-first presentation, category entry points and separation of browsing from commitment. No copied artwork, fake event supply, invented social proof or measured conversion gains.

Unattended cycle 235148 hit an explicit Codex usage limit and remains fault-latched; it is not implementing in the background. Host-edit work is retained. No credits purchased, paid fallback or retries. Current-session coordinator is reviewing event-detail continuity; discovery specialist has completed its assigned slice.

Existing production remains approved release d7064b7. Current discovery work, signup/HQ changes, chat-safety work and retained host editing are local unless separately stated. Product changes will be inspected at mobile and desktop sizes, under keyboard and reduced-motion interaction, and checked against server privacy and eligibility rules.
